headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: LAW (15)

summary: Lando Norris won the São Paulo Grand Prix from pole position, 10.4s ahead of Kimi Antonelli, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P19 to P3.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised TSU (10 second time penalty), PIA (10 second time penalty), HAM (5 second time penalty) and TSU (10 second time penalty).
There were 37 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 24 points over Oscar Piastri.
